name: Aokie Text to Speech
description: Dedicated text-to-speech service backed by the Aokie voice stack (aokie-voice-server.exe --mode tts) — synthesis only, exposed as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint (POST /v1/audio/speech) on a loopback port for FormLogic Flows' Speak text step and the receptionist's TTS source picker. The server binary ships with the Aokie plugin (aokie-voice-server.exe next to aokie-plugin.exe); install the Aokie plugin in the Plugins tab first. Default engine is pocket-tts ONNX; swap engines without editing this template via the card's Extra args — e.g. "--tts-engine sherpa" for fast Piper/VITS voices (or "--tts-engine pocket"), plus "--tts-model-dir DIR" pointing at a Piper/VITS voice folder (one .onnx + tokens.txt). The model loads lazily on first request (~200 MB RAM).
